quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Uber Launches Autonomous Rides in Europe (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Pony.ai: Uber launched autonomous rides on the Uber app in Zagreb, Croatia - the first time riders in Europe can book an AV with Uber (company claim) - with Pony.ai providing the autonomous driving solution (Pony.ai CEO: Gen-7 Robotaxi technology) and Verne acting as fleet owner and service operator; a licensed operator is on board at launch before fully driverless operations begin in the future. Zagreb is the first market under the partnership announced in March, moving it from development and testing to real-world deployment; the companies plan to scale the model to additional European cities, with the next markets to be announced later this year.
quarterly_data.figure: first European AV market on Uber; Gen-7 Robotaxi technology
